meta.policy: Keep a queen Miles bed reachable from both sides; nothing may collide or stop a door short; the main walkway from the hall door past the foot of the bed must stay at least 20 inches; bed sides at least 15 inches (today's north side is about 16.75); everything else is a trade-off measured against today. Priorities in order: main walkway, bed-side room, storage, fewest changes, cost.
meta.scenario_basis: Joint scenarios, not confidence bounds. Worst plausible: narrower room, 2.75-in stools, 19-in nightstand and camera hinge shifted north.

search.retained: Analytic invalids filtered; bed-wall / route-pattern / furniture-mix representatives ranked lexicographically by walkway band, window light/access (headboard glass counts double), bedside band, two nightstands, storage band, real products, changes, dated cost, then raw walkway. Bounded wall/floating/constraint-boundary search, not a global optimum.

verdict: Queen east ranks first with clear windows and two nightstands. West-wall dressers can be 18.2 inches deep with estimated drawers; under the north stool stay below 27 ± 1.5 inches tall, or use up to 22 inches depth and a 40-inch top for comfortable reach. Both requested dressers fit with the bathroom door closed but narrow the route when it opens; measure the sill and room width.
